info.title: oneocr - read text from images, and fine-tune the OneOcr line recognizer on your own documents
info.description: The oneocr command-line tool: fine-tune a recognition model from your own documents (train), measure it (eval) and work through the lines that need a human look (review).

options.name: --out
options.description:
tuned model (default <work>/model.onm)    --steps N (200)       --batch N (16)
--lr X (1e-4)       --seed N (1)       --held-out F (0.2)     --max-cer F (0: lines must read the same)
--degree N (min(4, cores))             --stop-after N

options.name: --restart
options.description:
throw away the checkpoint and start over (needed after a review import or new labels)
train --extract fine-tunes the document-extraction model for your own document type: --extract names a JSON Schema
whose top-level scalar properties are the fields; the labelling model reads each page for them, only values found
on the page become labels, and a new tag head (and, gently, the backbone) is trained on them. --model is a
docextract model file. The report gives per-field accuracy on held-out pages before and after, agreement with the
labelling model and a suggested LocalFirst threshold. Pages are read locally with the bundled models.

options.name: --steps
options.description:
(200)  --batch N (8)  --lr X (3e-3)  --seed N (1)  --held-out F (0.2)
--backbone-scale X (0.05; 0 trains only the new head)  --field-weight X (3)  --max-words N (384)

options.name: --instruction
options.description:
--stop-after N  --restart
Keys given with --key are visible to other users of the machine in the process list; prefer --key-from-env.

options.name: --llm-model
options.description: model name (the deployment name for azure-openai)

options.name: --base-url
options.description: for azure-openai (the endpoint) and openai-compatible

options.name: --key
options.description:
the API key; or --key-from-env <VAR> to read it from that environment variable
(nothing is read from the environment unless you name the variable)

options.name: --budget-usd
options.description: spend cap for this run; required except for openai-compatible
